DeepPhos.paper: Luo F, Wang M, Liu Y, Zhao X-M, Li A. DeepPhos: prediction of protein phosphorylation sites with deep learning. Bioinformatics 2019;35(16):2766-2773
DeepPhos.training_data_sources: Phospho.ELM, PhosphoSitePlus, HPRD, dbPTM 3.0, SysPTM; sequence redundancy reduced with CD-HIT at 40% similarity
DeepPhos.training_data_cutoff: not stated in the paper or repository
DeepPhos.basis: publication year of the version scored; positives first reported after this year cannot have entered the training data

MusiteDeep.paper: Wang D, Liu D, Yuchi J, He F, Jiang Y, Cai S, Li J, Xu D. MusiteDeep: a deep-learning based webserver for protein post-translational modification site prediction and visualization. Nucleic Acids Res 2020;48(W1):W140-W146
MusiteDeep.training_data_sources: not stated for the deployed phosphorylation models (the paper describes a benchmark using UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot sequences before 2010 for training and later annotations for testing)
MusiteDeep.training_data_cutoff: not stated for the deployed models
MusiteDeep.basis: publication year of the web-server version scored; the earlier 2017 MusiteDeep paper describes a previous version and is not the version scored

PhosF3C.published: Liu Y et al. Brief Bioinform 2025;26(3):bbaf242 (accepted 2025-05-01)
PhosF3C.scored_weights: checkpoints linked from the repository README (tyrosine checkpoint only was scored)
PhosF3C.training_data_sources: general data set fused from the MusiteDeep and DeepPSP data sets (UniProt/Swiss-Prot, PhosphoSitePlus, Phospho.ELM)
PhosF3C.basis: year of the earliest public description of the version scored (preprint and repository, December 2024); the peer-reviewed paper appeared in 2025

note: No tool states the date on which its training data collection ended. The restriction to positives first reported after the publication year is therefore conservative: it excludes every positive that could have been present at training and some that were not.
